about: Expected routing and delivery for visual-briefing. These are expectations for a human or model graded run over a transcript. tests/test_visual_briefing.py checks that this file is well formed and consistent with the skill text; it does not run a model, so it proves nothing about whether an agent routes this way.

cases.message: Finish the phase, and create an html if there are decisions.
cases.situation: Three decisions are open and the T3 render tools exist.
cases.check: The page he asked for is published by build.py, and the three picks are asked with the question tool, each option named by what it does and the question carrying the link; no local file path is offered as the delivery

cases.message: (no new message; an earlier one said: whenever there are decisions, bring me the HTML)
cases.situation: A new round of decisions appears.
cases.check: A new page with only the new round and one line to the previous one, published to Postplan, and the picks asked with the question tool

cases.situation: Answer to the round on screen.
cases.check: Decisions are applied and no new page is rendered

cases.message: Explain how the sync queue loses a write.
cases.situation: A diagram would carry the mechanism, more than a short answer.
cases.check: First screen carries the conclusion and the mechanism

cases.message: Put all of it in an organized HTML so I can learn it.
cases.situation: Long material that will exceed one frame at 360 px.
cases.check: A published Postplan link drawn from data (an understand page); never a file path

cases.message: Put it in a postplan and send me the link.
cases.check: build.py publishes the page and the link goes in the chat

cases.message: Prepare the quote comparison for the clinic.
cases.situation: The page carries client data and he did not ask to share it.
cases.check: No upload: the page carries client data, it is shown inline and a link waits until he asks for one
Without html_render the options still go out as a Postplan page and its link, and the pick is asked with the question tool where the harness has one

cases.situation: The child runs in its own thread.
cases.check: The child transcript has no html_render and returns a file path; the principal previews and renders

cases.message: Show me how the new card would look before you touch the real ones.
cases.check: design-grammar and frontend-design are called before the component is drawn, with every state

cases.message: Which branch is the PR on?
cases.check: Answer in the chat, no page

cases.message: (end of a turn that did work)
cases.situation: The result is a few lines.
cases.check: The closing paragraph in the chat

cases.message: Draft the quote for the client.
cases.check: Its own form; visual-briefing is not called

cases.message: Put this in Zoho as tickets.
cases.check: scrum is called; visual-briefing is not
workspace-files answers; visual-briefing is not called

cases.situation: The Postplan upload fails: no network or the instance is down.
cases.check: A standalone HTML file under Documents plans, its path in the chat, and the failed upload named with its error
